description: Project Progression Programme is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. This data view is being updated in line with connections reform and the new six-monthly application windows. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Connecting Generation, Connecting Demand. Its keywords are National Grid, Extra High Voltage (EHV), Connections. The portal shows 2025-07-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
